title.zh: 教育捐赠与储蓄计划（教育储蓄学生基金拨款）条例 2019
title.en: Education Endowment and Savings Schemes (Grant to Edusave Pupils Fund) Regulations 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Education Endowment and Savings Schemes (Grant to Edusave Pupils Fund) Regulations 2019 and come into operation on 15 June 2019.

2. For the purpose of section 6(1)(d) of the Act, the income of the Endowment Fund may be paid out and expended for the purpose of providing a top-up grant of $150 to be credited to the Edusave account of every member of the Edusave Pupils Fund who is eligible for the contribution under section 9(1) of the Act for the year 2019.
